overview.description: The First Trust Flexible Income ETF (FFLX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund actively manages a portfolio of fixed income securities that generate income. Debt securities may be of any sector, maturity, currency and geography. FFLX was launched on May 25, 2004 and is issued by First Trust.
